decision: Selected the Ordnance Survey National Grid reference that Virtus Holdco Limited's environmental-permit non-technical summary gives for the Saunderton Data Centre Campus (480790 198500), published by the Environment Agency with application EPR/SP3429LN/A001, as the campus locator. It was converted from British National Grid to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1. It is a site reference point for the four-building campus, not a building footprint, boundary or surveyed position.

selected_properties.document: Environmental Permit Application - Non-Technical Summary, Saunderton Data Centre Campus (prepared by Ramboll UK for Virtus Holdco Ltd; document control version 4.0, 23 April 2026)
selected_properties.permit_application: EPR/SP3429LN/A001 (new bespoke permit; Environment Agency consultation opened 28 July 2026, closed 25 August 2026)
selected_properties.buildings: four newly constructed data centre buildings: London 15, London 16, London 17 and London 18
selected_properties.standby_generation: 57 diesel standby generators, 356.22 MWth total rated thermal input on completion of all four buildings
selected_properties.grid_supply: on-site 132/20 kV primary substation fed from Amersham Grid, 120 MVA firm site capacity

transform.source_crs: EPSG:27700 (the document calls the values the Ordnance Survey National Grid reference)

consistency_checks.site_location_figure: NTS Figure 1.1 (rendered locally with pdftoppm) outlines the site west of the railway and Saunderton station, south of Haw Lane, and Figure 1.2 shows the four data-centre buildings (London 15 to 18), an electrical substation and an office building inside a quadrilateral installation boundary with Haw Lane along its north-western edge.
consistency_checks.postcode_centroid: The ONS centroid of HP14 4JD (postcodes.io: 480788, 198683; 51.681113, -0.832877) lies about 183 m north of the selected point, at the Haw Lane frontage of the site, so the grid reference is not a copy of the postcode centroid; the centroid is not used.
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery z17 tiles (x 65231-65233, y 43482-43484) viewed locally and not redistributed: the point falls near the middle of a large cleared and graded compound south of Haw Lane and west of the railway, with plant, stockpiles and a retained shed, matching the outline in Figure 1.1. The imagery date is unknown and is not used as status evidence.
consistency_checks.operator_pages: VIRTUS's Saunderton campus page describes four data centres delivering 78 MW of IT load on more than 50 acres; its February 2024 release calls the site a 50-acre freehold plot in Saunderton, Buckinghamshire.

uncertainty: The non-technical summary gives the grid reference to 10 m without a stated accuracy or a statement of which part of the site it marks; the campus covers more than 50 acres (about 20 ha), so its buildings extend a few hundred metres around the point.
